name: The Adventures Of Stubby Legged Man
author: LonelyWizard680
description: (controls) Use wasd and space to move. (current) Collect potatoes to progress (Coming soon) The Stubby Legged Man has made a wonderous ham sandwich, upon completing he realizes it has no cheese, he then sets out on an adventure to find some cheese, while adventuring he stumbles across the old Potato King, the King begs him to help him find the lost Potatolings, upon finding nearly all the potatolings, he stumbles across a potato cannon and while looking up at the moon, (Which we all know is made of cheese) a dark thought Crosses his mind.
